basic_details.job_title: TNSRLM Karur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Manager, Accountant Posts
basic_details.short_information: TNSRLM Karur Recruitment 2026 is for two contract posts at the Common Marketing Facility Centre (CMFC) in Karur district: Manager and Accountant. The posts come under the Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission, District Mission Management Unit – Karur. Send your application with a resume to the Manager, District People's Learning Centre (Magamai), near Mayanur Police Station, Krishnarayapuram Taluk. It must reach the office between 27 October 2026 and 5.00 PM on 3 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About TNSRLM Karur
content_sections.text: The District Mission Management Unit – Karur is the Karur district unit of the Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission, a Tamil Nadu government mission. The recruitment falls under the Non-Farm Livelihood annual action plan for 2025–2026. Under that plan, a Common Marketing Facility Centre (CMFC) is being set up to market products made by women's Self Help Groups (SHGs). The District Collector, Karur District, signed the notice.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice does not give an application form. Candidates send an application that includes their resume (personal details). It goes to this address, as printed in the notice: Manager, District People's Learning Centre (Magamai), Near Mayanur Police Station, Mayanur (Post), Krishnarayapuram Taluk, Karur District. Phone: 9384877521. Write your application, including your resume. Send it to the address above so that it reaches the office between 27 October 2026 and 5.00 PM on 3 November 2026. Applications that arrive after the fixed date will not be accepted. The notice does not name a postal mode or anything to write on the envelope. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a number of vacancies for either post, so each post is counted as 1 vacancy. Must be a graduate in Economics / Commerce / Marketing. Must also have guidance (exposure) in product value addition, branding and marketing. Postgraduates will be given preference. Must be a graduate with knowledge of design software. Must maintain all records and bank account books relating to the CMFC. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Karur Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate with CMFC support organisations and vendors for value addition, packing, packaging, branding and labelling. Arrange market linkages for the products of CMFC Self Help Groups, matched to their production volume. Coordinate with the various Technical Support Agencies (TSA), Project Management Units (PMU), DSMS and SSMS to help improve marketing facilities for SHG products. Coordinate customer preferences and marketing strategies by taking part in CMFC exhibitions, marketing strategies and other marketing promotion activities. Introduce SHG products on GeM, e-commerce and social media, and train SHGs on those marketing platforms. Guide the marketing of SHG products through vehicles and exhibitions. Have good knowledge of CMFC social media, video, photography and promotional tools for SHG products. Maintain all records, the bank account cash book and other books with the help of the CMFC computer.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TNSRLM Karur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Manager and 1 Accountant at the Common Marketing Facility Centre in Karur district. The notice does not print a number for either post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for TNSRLM Karur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office between 27 October 2026 and 5.00 PM on 3 November 2026. Applications that arrive after that will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the TNSRLM Karur Manager post?
faq.answer: A Manager candidate must be a graduate in Economics / Commerce / Marketing and must have guidance (exposure) in product value addition, branding and marketing. Postgraduates will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the TNSRLM Karur Accountant post?
faq.answer: An Accountant candidate must be a graduate with knowledge of design software. The Accountant must maintain all records and bank account books relating to the CMFC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the TNSRLM Karur Manager and Accountant posts?
faq.answer: The notice gives the pay as Rs.15000/- for the Manager post and Rs.10000/- for the Accountant post.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for TNSRLM Karur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send an application that includes your resume to: Manager, District People's Learning Centre (Magamai), Near Mayanur Police Station, Mayanur (Post), Krishnarayapuram Taluk, Karur District. It must reach the office by 5.00 PM on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TNSRLM Karur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the TNSRLM Karur CMFC job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary, as contract staff through outsourcing, and candidates cannot claim any right to permanent employment.
